content.text:
Keep `PUT /session`.

It creates/replaces the session; challenge verification is only the mechanism. `PUT /session/challenge` would imply updating the challenge itself.

Better rename controller action to `putSession` or `createSessionFromChallenge`, because `verifyChallenge()` also creates and returns a session.
